<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
<style>
  @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@500;700&display=swap');

  :root{
    --bg:#eef3f8; --surface:#ffffff; --ink:#2b2c33; --muted:#6b7280; --line:#e2e8f0;
    --navy:#004890; --navy-deep:#00305f; --cyan:#10a8e0; --cyan-deep:#0a6f9c;
    --done-soft:#e6f5fc; --done-ink:#0a6f9c;
    --shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,48,95,.05), 0 14px 34px -18px rgba(0,48,95,.30);
    --radius:16px;
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box}
  html,body{margin:0;height:100%}
  body{font-family:'Inter',system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);
    background:radial-gradient(1100px 560px at 88% -12%, #d4e8f6 0%, transparent 55%),
               radial-gradient(820px 480px at -8% 112%, #dbeaf6 0%, transparent 52%), var(--bg);
    -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;}
  .mono{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
  .wrap{max-width:980px;margin:0 auto;padding:24px 20px 56px}
  #gestor .wrap{max-width:1220px}
  button{font-family:inherit;cursor:pointer}
  button:focus-visible,input:focus-visible,textarea:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #9ed4ef;outline-offset:2px}

  /* ---------- LOGIN ---------- */
  #login{min-height:100vh;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:24px}
  .card{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:22px;
    box-shadow:var(--shadow);width:100%;max-width:400px;padding:32px 32px 28px;}
  .card .logo{display:block;width:168px;max-width:62%;height:auto;margin:0 auto 6px}
  .card .sub{text-align:center;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);letter-spacing:.06em;
    text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:18px}
  .field{margin-top:16px}
  .field label{display:block;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:6px}
  .field input{width:100%;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:11px;padding:12px 13px;
    font-size:15px;background:#f9fbfd;transition:border-color .15s, background .15s;}
  .field input:focus{border-color:var(--cyan);background:#fff}
  .hint{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:6px}
  .btn-primary{width:100%;margin-top:22px;border:0;border-radius:12px;padding:13px 16px;
    background:var(--navy);color:#fff;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;transition:filter .15s, transform .05s;}
  .btn-primary:hover{filter:brightness(1.12)} .btn-primary:active{transform:translateY(1px)}
  .btn-primary:disabled{opacity:.7;cursor:default}
  .error{margin-top:14px;font-size:13px;color:#b91c1c;background:#fdecec;border:1px solid #f7d4d4;
    border-radius:10px;padding:9px 11px;display:none;}
  .error.show{display:block}
  .login-foot{margin-top:18px;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.5;text-align:center}

  /* ---------- TOPBAR (compartilhado) ---------- */
  #app,#gestor{display:none}
  .topbar{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;margin-bottom:22px;flex-wrap:wrap}
  .topbar .logo{height:34px;width:auto;display:block}
  .topbar-right{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
  .chip{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius:999px;padding:5px 14px 5px 6px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
  .avatar{width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--navy);color:#fff;
    display:grid;place-items:center;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;flex:none}
  .chip small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;line-height:1.1}
  .chip b{font-size:13.5px;letter-spacing:-.1px}
  .chip.gestor .avatar{background:var(--cyan-deep)}
  .btn-ghost{border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:10px;padding:9px 13px;
    font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);transition:background .15s;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}
  .btn-ghost:hover{background:#f1f6fb}
  .btn-ghost.accent{color:var(--cyan-deep);border-color:#bfe4f6}
  .btn-ghost.accent:hover{background:#eef8fd}
  .btn-ghost svg{width:15px;height:15px}

  .hero{background:linear-gradient(120deg,var(--navy-deep) 0%, var(--navy) 52%, var(--cyan) 130%);
    color:#fff;border-radius:var(--radius);padding:26px 28px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);
    display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;flex-wrap:wrap;
    position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
  .hero::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;
    background:radial-gradient(440px 230px at 92% -40%, rgba(255,255,255,.22), transparent 70%);pointer-events:none}
  .hero .clock{font-size:clamp(42px,9vw,68px);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1px;line-height:1}
  .hero .date{font-size:14px;opacity:.9;margin-top:8px;text-transform:capitalize}
  .hero .tz{text-align:right;font-size:12px;opacity:.8}
  .hero .tz .live{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
  .hero .tz .live i{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#7fdcff;
    box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(127,220,255,.7);animation:pulse 2s infinite}
  @keyframes pulse{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(127,220,255,.6)}70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 7px rgba(127,220,255,0)}100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(127,220,255,0)}}

  .section-h{margin:26px 2px 12px;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.04em;
    text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
  .punch-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:14px}
  .punch{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);
    padding:18px 16px;text-align:left;box-shadow:var(--shadow);position:relative;
    transition:transform .12s, box-shadow .12s, border-color .12s;min-height:148px;
    display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;}
  .punch:not(:disabled):hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 16px 34px -18px rgba(0,48,95,.45);border-color:#c4dcef}
  .punch .tag{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-weight:600;font-size:14.5px}
  .punch.done .tag{padding-right:62px}
  .punch .tag .pip{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;flex:none}
  .punch .val{font-size:26px;font-weight:700;color:#aeb6c2;margin-top:auto}
  .punch .cta{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600}
  .punch.done{border-color:#bfe4f6;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff,#f7fcff)}
  .punch.done .val{color:var(--ink)} .punch.done .cta{color:var(--done-ink)}
  .punch.done::before{content:"✓";position:absolute;top:14px;right:15px;width:22px;height:22px;
    border-radius:50%;background:var(--done-soft);color:var(--done-ink);display:grid;place-items:center;
    font-size:13px;font-weight:700}
  .punch:disabled{cursor:default}
  .p0 .pip{background:var(--cyan)} .p1 .pip{background:var(--navy)}
  .p2 .pip{background:var(--cyan)} .p3 .pip{background:var(--navy)}
  .fix{position:absolute;top:11px;right:13px;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted);
    background:#eef4f9;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;padding:3px 8px;font-weight:600;display:none;z-index:2}
  .punch.done .fix{display:inline-block}
  .punch.done::before{display:none}

  .day-line{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;
    margin-top:14px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
  .day-line table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse}
  .day-line th{font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;color:var(--muted);
    font-weight:700;text-align:center;padding:11px 8px;background:#f7fafd;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
  .day-line td{text-align:center;padding:13px 8px;font-size:16px;font-weight:600}
  .day-line td.empty{color:#bcc4d0;font-weight:500}
  .day-line .lbl{text-align:left;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px;font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap}

  /* ---------- Justificativa + anexos ---------- */
  .just-card{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);
    box-shadow:var(--shadow);padding:18px 18px 16px}
  .just-card textarea{width:100%;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:11px;padding:12px 13px;
    font-family:inherit;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--ink);background:#f9fbfd;resize:vertical;min-height:84px;
    transition:border-color .15s, background .15s}
  .just-card textarea:focus{border-color:var(--cyan);background:#fff}
  .just-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-top:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
  .file-label{cursor:pointer}
  .just-status{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--done-ink);font-weight:600}
  .anexos-list{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-top:12px}
  .anexo-chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;background:#eef6fb;border:1px solid #cfe6f5;
    color:#0a5f86;border-radius:999px;padding:5px 11px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;max-width:100%}
  .anexo-chip span{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;max-width:220px}

  /* ---------- Tabelas (gestor) ---------- */
  .gestor-bar{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin:24px 2px 6px;flex-wrap:wrap}
  .gestor-bar h2{margin:0;font-size:18px;letter-spacing:-.2px}
  .gestor-bar p{margin:2px 0 0;font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)}
  .emp-card{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);
    box-shadow:var(--shadow);overflow:hidden;margin-top:16px}
  .emp-head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;padding:14px 18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:#f7fafd;justify-content:space-between}
  .emp-left{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;min-width:0}
  .btn-excluir{flex:none;border:1px solid #f0c2c9;background:#fff;color:#b0293f;border-radius:9px;
    padding:8px 13px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;transition:background .15s}
  .btn-excluir:hover{background:#fdeef0}
  .btn-excluir:disabled{opacity:.6;cursor:default}
  .emp-head b{font-size:15px}
  .emp-head small{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;display:block}
  .table-wrap{overflow:auto}
  table.hist{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;min-width:940px}
  table.hist th{font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;color:var(--muted);
    font-weight:700;text-align:left;padding:11px 14px;background:#fbfdff;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);white-space:nowrap}
  table.hist td{padding:11px 14px;font-size:14px;border-bottom:1px solid #f1f4f9;vertical-align:top}
  table.hist tr:last-child td{border-bottom:0}
  table.hist td.t{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;font-weight:500;white-space:nowrap}
  table.hist td.dash{color:#bcc4d0}
  table.hist td.just{max-width:240px;white-space:normal;color:#444}
  table.hist td.anex a{color:var(--cyan-deep);font-weight:600;text-decoration:none}
  table.hist td.anex a:hover{text-decoration:underline}
  table.hist td.anex a.anx-img{display:inline-block;margin:2px 4px 2px 0}
  table.hist td.anex a.anx-img img{display:block;width:76px;height:76px;object-fit:cover;
    border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#f2f6fa}
  table.hist td.nowrap{white-space:nowrap}
  table.hist td.hora{white-space:nowrap}
  table.hist td.hora .pin{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:3px;margin-left:7px;
    text-decoration:none;font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;
    border-radius:999px;padding:2px 7px 2px 5px;vertical-align:middle;border:1px solid transparent}
  table.hist td.hora .pin svg{width:11px;height:11px}
  table.hist td.hora .pin.exato{color:#0a6f9c;background:#e8f6fc;border-color:#c9e8f6}
  table.hist td.hora .pin.aprox{color:#8a6d1f;background:#fdf5e2;border-color:#f0e0b8}
  table.hist td.hora .pin.semloc{color:#98a0ad;background:#f4f6f9;border-color:#e6eaf0;cursor:help}
  table.hist td.hora .pin:hover{filter:brightness(.94);text-decoration:none}
  table.hist tr.fds td{background:#f7f8fb;color:#8a91a0}
  table.hist tr.row-falta td{background:#fdeef0}

  .painel-ctrls{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;
    flex-wrap:wrap;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;
    box-shadow:var(--shadow);padding:12px 16px;margin-bottom:6px}
  .periodo-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
  .periodo-nav .btn-ghost{padding:6px 12px;font-size:16px;line-height:1;font-weight:700}
  .periodo-nav .btn-ghost:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:default}
  .periodo-lbl{font-weight:700;font-size:14px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;min-width:190px;text-align:center}
  .cargo-filtro{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);display:flex;align-items:center}
  .cargo-filtro select{font-family:inherit;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);
    border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:8px 10px;background:#fff;margin-left:6px}
  .btn-falta{border:1px solid #f3c2c8;background:#fff;color:#c0334a;border-radius:9px;
    padding:6px 12px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;transition:background .15s}
  .btn-falta:hover{background:#fdeef0}
  .chip-falta{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;background:#fde6ea;color:#b0293f;
    border:1px solid #f3c2c8;border-radius:999px;padding:3px 10px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700}
  .chip-falta .falta-undo{color:#b0293f;text-decoration:none;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;
    font-size:14px;line-height:1;opacity:.7}
  .chip-falta .falta-undo:hover{opacity:1}
  table.hist .ok{color:var(--ok);font-weight:600;font-size:13px}
  table.hist td.acao{white-space:nowrap}
  .empty-state{padding:34px 18px;text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:14px;
    background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}

  @media(max-width:720px){.punch-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.hero{padding:22px}}
  @media(max-width:430px){.punch-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.punch{min-height:auto}}
  @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- ================= LOGIN ================= -->
<section id="login">
  <form class="card" id="loginForm" autocomplete="off">
    <img class="logo" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Saber Aprendizes" />
    <div class="sub">Registro de Ponto</div>
    <div class="field">
      <label for="user">Login</label>
      <input id="user" type="text" placeholder="nome.sobrenome" autocapitalize="none" spellcheck="false" />
      <div class="hint">Use o formato <b>nome.sobrenome</b></div>
    </div>
    <div class="field">
      <label for="pass">Senha</label>
      <input id="pass" type="password" placeholder="Digite sua senha" />
    </div>
    <div class="error" id="loginError"></div>
    <button class="btn-primary" type="submit">Entrar</button>
    <div class="login-foot">Primeiro acesso cadastra a senha automaticamente.<br>As marcações são gravadas na planilha do Drive.</div>
  </form>
</section>

<!-- ================= FUNCIONÁRIO ================= -->
<section id="app">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="topbar">
      <img class="logo" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Saber Aprendizes" />
      <div class="topbar-right">
        <div class="chip">
          <div class="avatar" id="avatar">--</div>
          <div><small id="whoCargo">Funcionário</small><b id="whoName">—</b></div>
        </div>
        <button class="btn-ghost" id="logoutBtn">Sair</button>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="hero">
      <div>
        <div class="clock mono" id="clock">--:--:--</div>
        <div class="date" id="todayDate">—</div>
      </div>
      <div class="tz"><div class="live"><i></i> Horário do servidor</div></div>
    </div>

    <div class="section-h">Marcações de hoje</div>
    <!-- AVISO DE LOCALIZAÇÃO (opcional): para exibir, remova os comentários da linha abaixo.
         Recomendado por transparência/LGPD, já que a localização é registrada em cada marcação.
    <div class="just-card" style="margin-bottom:14px;font-size:13px;color:#5b6470">
      Ao registrar o ponto, a localização do dispositivo é gravada junto com o horário
      para fins de conferência da jornada.
    </div>
    -->
    <div class="punch-grid" id="punchGrid"></div>

    <div class="day-line">
      <table>
        <thead><tr>
          <th class="lbl" style="text-align:left">Data</th>
          <th>Entrada</th><th>Saída p/ almoço</th><th>Retorno do almoço</th><th>Saída</th>
        </tr></thead>
        <tbody><tr id="todayRow">
          <td class="lbl" id="todayRowDate">—</td>
          <td class="empty" data-k="entrada">—</td>
          <td class="empty" data-k="saidaAlmoco">—</td>
          <td class="empty" data-k="retornoAlmoco">—</td>
          <td class="empty" data-k="saida">—</td>
        </tr></tbody>
      </table>
    </div>

    <div class="section-h">Justificativa e documentos</div>
    <div class="just-card">
      <textarea id="justInput" placeholder="Escreva uma justificativa para as marcações de hoje, se necessário (ex.: atraso, esquecimento de marcação, atestado)."></textarea>
      <div class="just-actions">
        <button class="btn-ghost" id="saveJustBtn">Salvar justificativa</button>
        <label class="btn-ghost accent file-label">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M21.44 11.05 12.25 20.24a5 5 0 0 1-7.07-7.07l9.19-9.19a3 3 0 0 1 4.24 4.24l-9.2 9.19a1 1 0 0 1-1.41-1.41l8.49-8.49"/></svg>
          Anexar documento
          <input type="file" id="fileInput" multiple hidden />
        </label>
        <span class="just-status" id="justStatus"></span>
      </div>
      <div class="anexos-list" id="anexosList"></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ================= GESTOR ================= -->
<section id="gestor">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="topbar">
      <img class="logo" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Saber Aprendizes" />
      <div class="topbar-right">
        <div class="chip gestor">
          <div class="avatar" id="gAvatar">--</div>
          <div><small>Gestor</small><b id="gName">—</b></div>
        </div>
        <button class="btn-ghost accent" id="refreshBtn">Atualizar</button>
        <button class="btn-ghost" id="gLogoutBtn">Sair</button>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="gestor-bar">
      <div>
        <h2>Painel do gestor</h2>
        <p>Marcações de todos os funcionários, por data (conforme a planilha).</p>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div id="gestorContent"></div>
  </div>
</section>

<script>
/* ---------- Ponte com o servidor ---------- */
/* ======================================================
   CONFIGURAÇÃO — cole aqui a URL /exec da sua implantação
   (Apps Script → Implantar → a URL termina em /exec)
   ====================================================== */
var API_URL = 'https://script.google.com/macros/s/AKfycbzLF4M9bSD2q-tAwWlGL5dt9EAGzeArH5pMW9alkkFPlM61q0Im7KtkGaiSSUcuF4qs6w/exec';

/* Ponte com a API.
   Usa POST com Content-Type text/plain de propósito: assim o navegador
   NÃO dispara preflight CORS (OPTIONS), que o Apps Script não responde. */
var ARG_MAP = {
  horaServidor:        [],
  fazerLogin:          ['login','senha'],
  obterDia:            ['login'],
  registrarPonto:      ['login','campo','loc'],
  corrigirPonto:       ['login','campo','loc'],
  salvarJustificativa: ['login','texto'],
  anexarDocumento:     ['login','nome','mime','dados'],
  obterPainelGestor:   ['login','senha','offset'],
  registrarFalta:      ['login','senha','alvo','dia'],
  removerFalta:        ['login','senha','alvo','dia'],
  excluirColaborador:  ['login','senha','alvo']
};

async function gs(fn){
  var vals = Array.prototype.slice.call(arguments, 1);
  var nomes = ARG_MAP[fn] || [];
  var params = {};
  nomes.forEach(function(n, i){ params[n] = vals[i]; });

  var resp = await fetch(API_URL, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'text/plain;charset=utf-8' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ action: fn, params: params }),
    redirect: 'follow'
  });
  if(!resp.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + resp.status);
  var txt = await resp.text();
  try { return JSON.parse(txt); }
  catch(e){ throw new Error('Resposta inesperada da API. Verifique se a implantação está como "Qualquer pessoa".'); }
}
function escapeHtml(s){
  return String(s == null ? '' : s)
    .replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;')
    .replace(/"/g,'&quot;').replace(/'/g,'&#39;');
}
function iniciais(nome){
  var p = String(nome||'').trim().split(/\s+/);
  return ((p[0]||'')[0]||'' ).toUpperCase() + ((p[1]||'')[0]||'').toUpperCase();
}

var PUNCHES = [
  {key:'entrada',       label:'Entrada',           cls:'p0'},
  {key:'saidaAlmoco',   label:'Saída para almoço', cls:'p1'},
  {key:'retornoAlmoco', label:'Retorno do almoço', cls:'p2'},
  {key:'saida',         label:'Saída',             cls:'p3'}
];
var currentUser = null, currentNome = null, currentCargo = '', today = null, managerSenha = null;
var gestorState = { offset: 0, cargo: '', dados: null };

/* ---------- LOGIN ---------- */
var loginForm  = document.getElementById('loginForm');
var loginError = document.getElementById('loginError');
function showErr(msg){ loginError.textContent = msg; loginError.classList.add('show'); }

loginForm.addEventListener('submit', async function(e){
  e.preventDefault();
  loginError.classList.remove('show');
  var user = document.getElementById('user').value.trim().toLowerCase();
  var pass = document.getElementById('pass').value;
  var btn  = loginForm.querySelector('.btn-primary');
  btn.disabled = true; btn.textContent = 'Entrando...';
  try{
    var r = await gs('fazerLogin', user, pass);
    if(!r.ok){ showErr(r.erro); return; }
    currentUser = r.login; currentNome = r.nome; currentCargo = r.cargo || '';
    if(r.gestor){ managerSenha = pass; await enterGestor(); }
    else { await enterApp(); }
  }catch(err){
    showErr('Erro de comunicação com o servidor. Recarregue a página e tente novamente.');
  }finally{
    btn.disabled = false; btn.textContent = 'Entrar';
  }
});

function backToLogin(){
  currentUser = null; managerSenha = null;
  document.getElementById('pass').value = '';
  document.getElementById('app').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('gestor').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('login').style.display = 'grid';
}
document.getElementById('logoutBtn').addEventListener('click', backToLogin);
document.getElementById('gLogoutBtn').addEventListener('click', backToLogin);

/* ================= FUNCIONÁRIO ================= */
async function enterApp(){
  document.getElementById('login').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('gestor').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('app').style.display = 'block';
  document.getElementById('avatar').textContent = iniciais(currentNome);
  document.getElementById('whoName').textContent = currentNome;
  document.getElementById('whoCargo').textContent = currentCargo || 'Funcionário';
  buildPunchGrid();
  syncServerTime().then(tick);
  await renderToday();
}

function buildPunchGrid(){
  var grid = document.getElementById('punchGrid');
  grid.innerHTML = '';
  PUNCHES.forEach(function(p){
    var b = document.createElement('button');
    b.className = 'punch ' + p.cls;
    b.dataset.key = p.key;
    b.innerHTML =
      '<span class="tag"><span class="pip"></span>' + p.label + '</span>' +
      '<span class="fix" data-fix="' + p.key + '">corrigir</span>' +
      '<span class="val" data-val="' + p.key + '">--:--</span>' +
      '<span class="cta">Toque para registrar</span>';
    b.addEventListener('click', function(ev){
      if(ev.target.dataset.fix){ ev.stopPropagation(); correctPunch(p.key); return; }
      registerPunch(p.key);
    });
    grid.appendChild(b);
  });
}

/* Localização da marcação.
   Agora a página é servida pelo Firebase Hosting (HTTPS, sem iframe), então o
   GPS funciona normalmente: o navegador exibe seu pedido de permissão e a
   precisão fica na casa de metros. Se o colaborador negar ou o GPS falhar,
   caímos na localização aproximada por rede/IP. */
function localGPS(){
  return new Promise(function(res){
    if(!navigator.geolocation){ res(null); return; }
    var fim = false;
    var t = setTimeout(function(){ if(!fim){ fim = true; res(null); } }, 6000);
    try{
      navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(function(p){
        if(fim) return; fim = true; clearTimeout(t);
        res({ lat: p.coords.latitude, lng: p.coords.longitude,
              acc: p.coords.accuracy, fonte: 'gps' });
      }, function(){
        if(fim) return; fim = true; clearTimeout(t);
        res(null);
      }, { enableHighAccuracy: true, timeout: 6000, maximumAge: 30000 });
    }catch(e){ if(!fim){ fim = true; clearTimeout(t); res(null); } }
  });
}

async function localIP(){
  // Serviços públicos de geolocalização por IP (sem permissão, precisão de cidade)
  var fontes = [
    { url: 'https://ipapi.co/json/', mapa: function(j){ return { lat:j.latitude, lng:j.longitude, cidade:(j.city||'')+(j.region_code?(' - '+j.region_code):'') }; } },
    { url: 'https://ipwho.is/',      mapa: function(j){ return { lat:j.latitude, lng:j.longitude, cidade:(j.city||'')+(j.region_code?(' - '+j.region_code):'') }; } }
  ];
  for(var i=0;i<fontes.length;i++){
    try{
      var ctl = new AbortController();
      var to = setTimeout(function(){ ctl.abort(); }, 6000);
      var r = await fetch(fontes[i].url, { signal: ctl.signal });
      clearTimeout(to);
      if(!r.ok) continue;
      var j = await r.json();
      var m = fontes[i].mapa(j);
      var lat = Number(m.lat), lng = Number(m.lng);
      if(isFinite(lat) && isFinite(lng) && (lat !== 0 || lng !== 0)){
        return { lat: lat, lng: lng, acc: 5000, fonte: 'ip', cidade: m.cidade || '' };
      }
    }catch(e){}
  }
  return null;
}

async function obterLocal(){
  var g = await localGPS();
  if(g) return g;
  return await localIP();
}

async function registerPunch(key){
  var btn = document.querySelector('.punch[data-key="' + key + '"]');
  if(btn.classList.contains('done') || btn.dataset.busy) return;
  btn.dataset.busy = '1';
  btn.querySelector('.cta').textContent = 'Registrando...';
  var loc = await obterLocal();
  var resp = null;
  try{ resp = await gs('registrarPonto', currentUser, key, loc); }catch(e){}
  delete btn.dataset.busy;
  if(resp && resp.registro){ applyRecord(resp.registro); }
  else{ await renderToday(); }
}

async function correctPunch(key){
  var label = PUNCHES.filter(function(p){return p.key===key;})[0].label;
  if(!confirm('Refazer a marcação de "' + label + '" com o horário atual?')) return;
  var loc = await obterLocal();
  var resp = null;
  try{ resp = await gs('corrigirPonto', currentUser, key, loc); }catch(e){}
  if(resp && resp.registro){ applyRecord(resp.registro); }
  else{ await renderToday(); }
}

/* Justificativa */
document.getElementById('saveJustBtn').addEventListener('click', async function(){
  var btn = this; var txt = document.getElementById('justInput').value;
  btn.disabled = true; setStatus('Salvando...');
  var resp = null;
  try{ resp = await gs('salvarJustificativa', currentUser, txt); }catch(e){}
  btn.disabled = false;
  if(resp && resp.registro){ applyRecord(resp.registro); setStatus('Justificativa salva.'); }
  else{ setStatus('Não foi possível salvar.'); }
});

/* Anexos */
document.getElementById('fileInput').addEventListener('change', async function(){
  var files = Array.prototype.slice.call(this.files); this.value = '';
  for(var i=0;i<files.length;i++){
    var f = files[i];
    if(f.size > 10*1024*1024){ setStatus('"' + f.name + '" passa de 10 MB e não foi enviado.'); continue; }
    setStatus('Enviando ' + f.name + '...');
    try{
      var b64 = await fileToBase64(f);
      var resp = await gs('anexarDocumento', currentUser, f.name, f.type, b64);
      if(resp && resp.registro){ applyRecord(resp.registro); }
    }catch(e){ setStatus('Falha ao enviar ' + f.name + '.'); continue; }
  }
  setStatus('Documento(s) anexado(s).');
});
function fileToBase64(file){
  return new Promise(function(res, rej){
    var fr = new FileReader();
    fr.onload = function(){ res(String(fr.result).split(',')[1]); };
    fr.onerror = rej;
    fr.readAsDataURL(file);
  });
}
function setStatus(s){ document.getElementById('justStatus').textContent = s; }

/* Render do funcionário */
function applyRecord(rec){
  rec = rec || {};
  document.getElementById('todayRowDate').textContent = rec.data || today || '';
  PUNCHES.forEach(function(p){
    var btn  = document.querySelector('.punch[data-key="' + p.key + '"]');
    var val  = btn.querySelector('[data-val="' + p.key + '"]');
    var cta  = btn.querySelector('.cta');
    var cell = document.querySelector('#todayRow [data-k="' + p.key + '"]');
    if(rec[p.key]){
      btn.classList.add('done');
      val.textContent = rec[p.key];
      cta.textContent = 'Registrado às ' + rec[p.key];
      cell.textContent = rec[p.key]; cell.classList.remove('empty');
    }else{
      btn.classList.remove('done');
      val.textContent = '--:--';
      cta.textContent = 'Toque para registrar';
      cell.textContent = '—'; cell.classList.add('empty');
    }
  });
  var jt = document.getElementById('justInput');
  if(jt && document.activeElement !== jt) jt.value = rec.justificativa || '';
  renderAnexos(rec.anexos || []);
  if(rec.cargo){ currentCargo = rec.cargo; document.getElementById('whoCargo').textContent = rec.cargo; }
}
function renderAnexos(list){
  var box = document.getElementById('anexosList');
  if(!list.length){ box.innerHTML = ''; return; }
  box.innerHTML = list.map(function(a){
    return '<span class="anexo-chip">📎 <span>' + escapeHtml(a.nome || 'documento') + '</span></span>';
  }).join('');
}

async function renderToday(){
  var rec = {};
  try{ rec = (await gs('obterDia', currentUser)) || {}; }catch(e){}
  applyRecord(rec);
}

/* ================= GESTOR ================= */
async function enterGestor(){
  document.getElementById('login').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('app').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('gestor').style.display = 'block';
  document.getElementById('gAvatar').textContent = iniciais(currentNome);
  document.getElementById('gName').textContent = currentNome;
  await carregarPainel();
}
document.getElementById('refreshBtn').addEventListener('click', carregarPainel);

var WD = ['Dom','Seg','Ter','Qua','Qui','Sex','Sáb'];

async function carregarPainel(){
  var root = document.getElementById('gestorContent');
  root.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state">Carregando marcações...</div>';
  var resp = null, erro = null;
  try{ resp = await gs('obterPainelGestor', currentUser, managerSenha, gestorState.offset); }
  catch(e){ erro = (e && e.message) ? e.message : String(e); }
  if(erro){
    root.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state"><b>Erro ao falar com o servidor:</b><br>' + escapeHtml(erro) +
      '<br><br>Se você atualizou o código, publique uma <b>nova versão</b> da implantação ' +
      '(Implantar → Gerenciar implantações → ✏️ Editar → Versão: Nova versão).</div>';
    return;
  }
  if(!resp || !resp.ok){
    root.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state">' + escapeHtml((resp && resp.erro) || 'Não foi possível carregar o painel.') + '</div>';
    return;
  }
  gestorState.dados = resp;
  gestorState.offset = resp.offset;
  if(gestorState.cargo && (resp.cargos || []).indexOf(gestorState.cargo) === -1) gestorState.cargo = '';
  renderPainel();
}

function renderPainel(){
  var resp = gestorState.dados; if(!resp) return;
  var root = document.getElementById('gestorContent');

  var opts = ['<option value="">Todos os cargos</option>'].concat(
    (resp.cargos || []).map(function(cg){
      return '<option value="' + escapeHtml(cg) + '"' + (cg === gestorState.cargo ? ' selected' : '') + '>' + escapeHtml(cg) + '</option>';
    })
  ).join('');
  var nextDisabled = gestorState.offset >= 0 ? ' disabled' : '';
  var controles =
    '<div class="painel-ctrls">' +
      '<div class="periodo-nav">' +
        '<button class="btn-ghost" id="periodoPrev" title="Período anterior">&#8249;</button>' +
        '<span class="periodo-lbl">' + escapeHtml(resp.periodo.inicio) + ' &ndash; ' + escapeHtml(resp.periodo.fim) + '</span>' +
        '<button class="btn-ghost" id="periodoNext"' + nextDisabled + ' title="Próximo período">&#8250;</button>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<label class="cargo-filtro">Cargo: <select id="cargoSelect">' + opts + '</select></label>' +
    '</div>';

  var lista = (resp.colaboradores || []).filter(function(c){
    return !gestorState.cargo || c.cargo === gestorState.cargo;
  });

  var cards;
  if(!lista.length){
    cards = '<div class="empty-state">Nenhum colaborador' + (gestorState.cargo ? ' com o cargo selecionado' : ' cadastrado') + '.</div>';
  } else {
    cards = lista.map(function(c){ return cardColaborador(c); }).join('');
  }

  root.innerHTML = controles + cards;

  var prev = document.getElementById('periodoPrev');
  var next = document.getElementById('periodoNext');
  if(prev) prev.addEventListener('click', function(){ gestorState.offset -= 1; carregarPainel(); });
  if(next) next.addEventListener('click', function(){ if(gestorState.offset < 0){ gestorState.offset += 1; carregarPainel(); } });
  var sel = document.getElementById('cargoSelect');
  if(sel) sel.addEventListener('change', function(){ gestorState.cargo = this.value; renderPainel(); });
}

function anexosHtml(lista){
  return (lista || []).map(function(a, i){
    var nm = escapeHtml(a.nome || ('doc ' + (i+1)));
    var url = escapeHtml(a.url || '#');
    var ehImg = (a.mime && a.mime.indexOf('image/') === 0) || /\.(png|jpe?g|gif|webp|bmp|heic)$/i.test(a.nome || '');
    if(ehImg && a.id){
      var thumb = 'https://drive.google.com/thumbnail?id=' + encodeURIComponent(a.id) + '&sz=w300';
      return '<a class="anx-img" href="' + url + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener" title="' + nm + '"><img src="' + escapeHtml(thumb) + '" alt="' + nm + '" loading="lazy" /></a>';
    }
    return '<a href="' + url + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener">' + nm + '</a>';
  }).join('<br>');
}

function cardColaborador(c){
  var rows = c.dias.map(function(d){
    var fds = (d.dow === 0 || d.dow === 6) ? ' fds' : '';
    var L = {};
    try{
      var raw = (d.locaisJson != null) ? d.locaisJson : d.locais;
      if(typeof raw === 'string'){ L = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : {}; }
      else if(raw && typeof raw === 'object'){ L = raw; }
    }catch(e){ L = {}; }
    // Cada horário registrado ganha um link de localização (mapa).
    function cel(v, campo){
      if(!v) return '<td class="dash">—</td>';
      var loc = L[campo];
      var pin = '';
      var lat = loc ? Number(loc.lat) : NaN, lng = loc ? Number(loc.lng) : NaN;
      if(isFinite(lat) && isFinite(lng)){
        var acc = (loc.acc == null || loc.acc === '') ? null : Number(loc.acc);
        var url = 'https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=' + lat + ',' + lng;
        var exato = (loc.fonte !== 'ip') && (acc != null && isFinite(acc) && acc <= 100);
        var titulo;
        if(exato){
          titulo = 'Local exato (GPS, ±' + Math.round(acc) + ' m) — ' + lat + ', ' + lng;
        } else {
          titulo = 'Local aproximado' + (loc.fonte === 'ip' ? ' (por rede/IP' + (loc.cidade ? ': ' + loc.cidade : '') + ')' : '') +
                   ((acc != null && isFinite(acc)) ? (' — precisão ~' + Math.round(acc) + ' m') : '') +
                   ' — ' + lat + ', ' + lng;
        }
        pin = '<a class="pin ' + (exato ? 'exato' : 'aprox') + '" href="' + url + '" target="_blank" rel="noopener" title="' + escapeHtml(titulo) + '">' +
              '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">' +
              '<path d="M12 21s-7-6.1-7-11a7 7 0 1 1 14 0c0 4.9-7 11-7 11z"/><circle cx="12" cy="10" r="2.6"/></svg>' +
              '<span>' + (exato ? 'exato' : 'aprox.') + '</span></a>';
      } else {
        pin = '<span class="pin semloc" title="Sem localização: o colaborador negou a permissão de GPS, ou a marcação foi feita antes desta atualização.">s/ local</span>';
      }
      return '<td class="t hora">' + escapeHtml(v) + pin + '</td>';
    }
    var situ, acao;
    if(d.falta){
      situ = '<span class="chip-falta">Falta <a class="falta-undo" data-login="' + escapeHtml(c.login) + '" data-data="' + escapeHtml(d.data) + '" title="Desfazer">&times;</a></span>';
      acao = '';
    } else if(d.vazio){
      situ = '<span class="dash">—</span>';
      acao = '<button class="btn-falta" data-login="' + escapeHtml(c.login) + '" data-data="' + escapeHtml(d.data) + '">Falta</button>';
    } else {
      situ = '<span class="ok">Presente</span>';
      acao = '';
    }
    return '<tr class="' + (d.falta ? 'row-falta' : '') + fds + '">' +
      '<td class="t nowrap">' + WD[d.dow] + ' ' + escapeHtml(d.data) + '</td>' +
      cel(d.entrada, 'entrada') + cel(d.saidaAlmoco, 'saidaAlmoco') +
      cel(d.retornoAlmoco, 'retornoAlmoco') + cel(d.saida, 'saida') +
      '<td class="t">' + (d.horas || '—') + '</td>' +
      '<td>' + situ + '</td>' +
      '<td class="just">' + (d.justificativa ? escapeHtml(d.justificativa) : '<span class="dash">—</span>') + '</td>' +
      '<td class="anex">' + (anexosHtml(d.anexos) || '<span class="dash">—</span>') + '</td>' +
      '<td class="acao">' + acao + '</td>' +
    '</tr>';
  }).join('');
  return '<div class="emp-card">' +
    '<div class="emp-head">' +
      '<div class="emp-left"><div class="avatar">' + iniciais(c.nome) + '</div>' +
        '<div><b>' + escapeHtml(c.nome) + '</b><small>' + escapeHtml(c.login) + (c.cargo ? ' · ' + escapeHtml(c.cargo) : '') + '</small></div></div>' +
      '<button class="btn-excluir" data-login="' + escapeHtml(c.login) + '" data-nome="' + escapeHtml(c.nome) + '">Excluir colaborador</button>' +
    '</div>' +
    '<div class="table-wrap"><table class="hist"><thead><tr>' +
      '<th>Data</th><th>Entrada</th><th>Saída p/ almoço</th><th>Retorno do almoço</th>' +
      '<th>Saída</th><th>Horas</th><th>Situação</th><th>Justificativa</th><th>Anexos</th><th>Ação</th>' +
    '</tr></thead><tbody>' + rows + '</tbody></table></div></div>';
}

document.getElementById('gestorContent').addEventListener('click', async function(ev){
  var b = ev.target && ev.target.closest ? ev.target.closest('.btn-falta') : null;
  var u = ev.target && ev.target.closest ? ev.target.closest('.falta-undo') : null;
  var x = ev.target && ev.target.closest ? ev.target.closest('.btn-excluir') : null;
  if(b){
    b.disabled = true; b.textContent = '...';
    try{ await gs('registrarFalta', currentUser, managerSenha, b.getAttribute('data-login'), b.getAttribute('data-data')); }catch(e){}
    await carregarPainel();
  } else if(u){
    ev.preventDefault();
    try{ await gs('removerFalta', currentUser, managerSenha, u.getAttribute('data-login'), u.getAttribute('data-data')); }catch(e){}
    await carregarPainel();
  } else if(x){
    var nome = x.getAttribute('data-nome') || 'este colaborador';
    var lg   = x.getAttribute('data-login');
    if(!confirm('Excluir o colaborador "' + nome + '"?\n\nTodos os registros de ponto dele serão apagados da planilha e do painel. Esta ação não pode ser desfeita.')) return;
    x.disabled = true; x.textContent = 'Excluindo...';
    try{ await gs('excluirColaborador', currentUser, managerSenha, lg); }catch(e){}
    await carregarPainel();
  }
});

/* ---------- RELÓGIO sincronizado com o SERVIDOR ---------- */
/* O horário exibido vem do servidor (fuso America/Sao_Paulo) e avança por um
   cronômetro monotônico (performance.now), então alterar o relógio/fuso do
   dispositivo NÃO muda o que aparece — e a marcação gravada já usa a hora do
   servidor de qualquer forma. */
var serverEpoch = 0, perfAtSync = 0, timeSynced = false;

async function syncServerTime(){
  try{
    var t0 = performance.now();
    var r = await gs('horaServidor');
    var t1 = performance.now();
    if(r && r.ms){
      serverEpoch = r.ms + (t1 - t0) / 2;   // compensa metade do tempo de ida/volta
      perfAtSync = t1;
      timeSynced = true;
    }
  }catch(e){}
}

function agoraMs(){
  return timeSynced ? (serverEpoch + (performance.now() - perfAtSync)) : Date.now();
}

var OPTS_TZ = { timeZone: 'America/Sao_Paulo' };
function tick(){
  var d = new Date(agoraMs());
  today = d.toLocaleDateString('pt-BR', OPTS_TZ);
  var c = document.getElementById('clock');
  if(c) c.textContent = d.toLocaleTimeString('pt-BR', {hour12:false, timeZone:'America/Sao_Paulo'});
  var el = document.getElementById('todayDate');
  if(el) el.textContent = d.toLocaleDateString('pt-BR',
    {weekday:'long', day:'2-digit', month:'long', year:'numeric', timeZone:'America/Sao_Paulo'});
}
setInterval(tick, 1000); tick();
syncServerTime().then(tick);
setInterval(syncServerTime, 5 * 60 * 1000);   // ressincroniza a cada 5 min
</script>
</body>
</html>
